review_candidates.description: Linux Systems Administrator LegalSight is a creative and innovative company that develops software for a broad range of legal and business functions. Our team includes veterans of the legal services industry, technology experts, and business operations professionals. We leverage our expertise to maximize opportunities for improved workflows and processes. We bring together our talent and technology to help clients achieve greater operational efficiency, reduce risks, and take advantage of innovative software solutions. We're looking for a hands-on Linux Systems Administrator who likes getting into the guts of a system and making it perform optimally. The candidate must take ownership of the infrastructure and keep it healthy and secure.You'll manage our Linux servers, virtualization, cloud footprint, and network edge, and you'll have plenty of latitude to shape how it all fits together. We expect strong Linux fundamentals, a genuine curiosity about how systems work, and the drive to grow into the unfamiliar parts. We need someone who is comfortable reading logs, scripting fixes, and documenting their work. In your first few months you'll take ownership of the Linux and virtualization environment, help move us off SonicWall onto OPNsense cleanly, and put automation and monitoring in place so the infrastructure runs quietly and predictably. Over time you'll grow into the broader systems role we need, steadily making the environment more secure and more automated. **Candidates must live within commutable distance to our office in Ocean City, NJ and must be able to work in-office two (2) days per week. Responsibilities: Administer and maintain Linux servers (Ubuntu): provisioning, patching, hardening, storage, users/permissions, and day-to-day troubleshooting. Manage our Proxmox virtualization environment: VMs and containers, resource allocation, snapshots, backups, and keeping the cluster healthy. Own the network edge and firewall: we currently run SonicWall and are transitioning to OPNsense, so you'll help drive that migration and then run it (firewall rules, VPN, DNS, and routing). Automate the repetitive stuff: write Bash/Python scripts so routine admin work, provisioning, and monitoring run themselves instead of consuming your day. We leverage AI tooling (including Claude) day-to-day, and you're welcome to use it here too. Set up and maintain monitoring, alerting, logging, and backups/restores. Support the infrastructure our engineering team builds upon: Docker container hosts, deployment targets, and databases. Operate and maintain our AWS footprint: EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, and VPC networking, all while maintaining an eye on cost, security, and reliability. Respond to incidents, dig into root causes, and put fixes in place that keep problems from recurring. Document configurations and procedures so the environment is maintainable by more than just you. Required Qualifications: 3+ years of hands-on Linux administration in a production environment. Must be comfortable at the command line, networking, storage, and package management. A doer's mindset. You'd rather fix the thing and script it than file a ticket and wait. You must be willing to take ownership and follow through without being chased. Solid scripting for automation (Bash required, Python or similar a strong plus). Working knowledge of virtualization: Proxmox specifically is ideal, but solid KVM/hypervisor experience translates. Sound networking fundamentals: firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, DNS, and routing. Must know enough to run and troubleshoot the network edge. Some AWS exposure (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC) and must be clearly capable of ramping quickly on the unknown components. Curiosity and the drive to grow into the areas of the stack you haven't mastered yet. Clear written communication and a habit of documenting what you build. Preferred/Nice-to-Have Qualifications: Hands-on Proxmox experience specifically (clustering, backups, ZFS/Ceph storage). OPNsense or pfSense firewall experience (bonus if you've run a SonicWall-to-OPNsense-style migration before). Experience configuring network switches with MLAG, preferably using MikroTik devices. Docker experience and comfortable creating highly-integrated container stacks. PostgreSQL or general database operations experience. Experience with AI tooling (e.g., Claude) for scripting, troubleshooting, or automation (we use it here, so hands-on experience is a plus). Relevant certifications (e.g., LPIC, RHCSA, or AWS SysOps/Solutions Architect).

review_candidates.description: Het vertrouwen dat je wil. Zonder erom te moeten vragen. Werken bij Moore, da’s business as unusual. Als System Engineer ben je een belangrijke schakel binnen ons sysadmin-team. Je combineert cloudbeheer met klassieke infrastructuurprojecten en helpt mee bouwen aan een veilige, performante en toekomstgerichte IT-omgeving voor onze organisatie. Wat zijn jouw belangrijkste taken? Je beheert, optimaliseert en verder ontwikkelt onze Azure-omgeving en Microsoft 365-infrastructuur. Je bewaakt de performantie, beschikbaarheid, security en kostenefficiëntie van onze cloudomgeving. Je helpt mee de brug te slaan tussen onze cloud- en on-premises infrastructuur en bewaakt de samenhang tussen beide. Je neemt ownership over infrastructuurprojecten, van analyse en ontwerp tot implementatie en opvolging. Je automatiseert beheertaken via PowerShell en andere automatiseringstools om onze IT-omgeving efficiënter en schaalbaarder te maken. Je analyseert en lost complexe incidenten op binnen onze tweede- en derdelijnsondersteuning. Je waakt mee over monitoring, patching, security en de algemene stabiliteit van onze systemen. Je documenteert oplossingen, deelt jouw expertise binnen het team en begeleidt junior collega's in hun verdere ontwikkeling. Je volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen het Microsoft- en Azure-ecosysteem op en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteringen. Word jij onze nieuwe companion? Welke kennis en ervaring verwachten we van jou? Je hebt ruime ervaring met Azure, Microsoft 365 en cloudinfrastructuur. Je beschikt over een sterke kennis van Windows Server, Active Directory en netwerkinfrastructuur. Je hebt ervaring met scripting en automatisering, bij voorkeur in PowerShell. Kennis van Infrastructure as Code, zoals Bicep of Terraform, is een mooie troef. Je hebt ervaring met hybride cloud- en on-premises omgevingen en begrijpt de uitdagingen die hierbij komen kijken. Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels. Kennis van het Frans is een plus. Je denkt op architectuurniveau en houdt rekening met schaalbaarheid, security en kostenefficiëntie. Je neemt ownership over projecten en brengt deze succesvol van analyse tot implementatie. Je deelt graag jouw kennis en fungeert als aanspreekpunt en mentor voor minder ervaren collega's. Je hebt interesse in cloud security, governance en identity management binnen Azure. Microsoft Azure-certificeringen zijn een sterke troef. Je volgt evoluties binnen het Microsoft- en Azure-ecosysteem actief op en zet nieuwe inzichten om in concrete verbeteringen. Waarom kiezen voor Moore? Dat is kiezen voor: Het vertrouwen dat je wil. Zonder erom te moeten vragen. Werken bij Moore, da’s business as unusual. Bestaat er een standaard pad om je carrière uit te bouwen? Niet bij Moore. Bij ons groei je op je eigen tempo, in de richting die jij kiest. Je krijgt de coaching en de autonomie om impact te maken. Want waarom zou je een standaard System Engineer willen zijn als je bij Moore zoveel méér kan betekenen? Ondernemen, innoveren en delen zijn onze kernwaarden. Ze vormen de rode draad in alles wat we doen, niet alleen voor onze klanten, maar ook voor onze companions. Je uitvalsbasis is Antwerpen en Brussel maar door ons uitgebreid kantorennetwerk en onze policy van plaats- en tijdsonafhankelijk werken, behoort thuiswerk (in combinatie met werken in een kantoor in de nabijheid van de woonplaats) tot de mogelijkheden. Zo blijft jouw privéleven ook in balans. Je ontvangt een competitief loon dat volledig in lijn ligt met jouw ervaring en capaciteiten, aangevuld met heel wat andere interessante voordelen. Je komt terecht in een team van experten dat aan de beleving van kandidaten en medewerkers werkt, binnen een warme organisatie waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn. En daarom vinden onze medewerkers Moore Belgium een goede werkplek en ‘a Great Place to Work’ ©

Cloud Engineer – AWS (Windows Linux) Role Overview We are seeking a Level 2 Cloud Engineer to support and operate Windows and Linux workloads hosted on AWS , within a secure, multi‑account cloud environment covering UAT and Production . This role focuses on day‑to‑day operational support, validation, troubleshooting, and remediation for OS‑level and cloud services, supporting AWS infrastructure initiatives involving secure ingress/egress, network firewalls, load balancers, and controlled connectivity . The engineer will work closely with cloud, network, and security teams in a regulated enterprise environment. Key Responsibilities Windows Linux OS Support (L2) Provide Level 2 operational support for: Windows Server (2016 / 2019 / 2022) Linux distributions (RHEL, Amazon Linux, Ubuntu) Perform OS‑level troubleshooting, service restarts, performance checks, and log analysis. Support core platform services: Windows: AD, DNS, GPO, WSUS Linux: systemd services, cron, filesystem, package management (yum/apt) Handle incidents, problems, and service requests via ITSM tools. AWS Cloud Operations Support Support workloads running on core AWS services: EC2, EBS, S3 AWS Systems Manager (SSM) – Run Command, Patch Manager, Session Manager Amazon CloudWatch – logs, metrics, alarms Assist with: Instance provisioning and validation Start/stop, resize, snapshot, and recovery activities Support UAT and PROD operational readiness and BAU handover. Network, Ingress Egress Support (Mandatory) Support AWS environments with: Internet and Intranet-based ingress and egress traffic flows VPCs, subnets, route tables, and security groups Integration with web security and traffic management services such as AWS WAF Work with network and security teams to: Validate end-to-end connectivity paths for Windows and Linux servers Design and support Layer 4 and Layer 7 load balancing using AWS Network Load Balancer and AWS Application Load Balancer Implement and manage API exposure and routing using Amazon API Gateway Configure and support forward and reverse proxy solutions (e.g., NGINX) Troubleshoot connectivity, DNS resolution, proxy routing, and firewall-related issues Support secure ingress and egress architecture by: Implementing reverse proxy, forward proxy, and web application firewall (WAF) patterns Ensuring secure access control, SSL/TLS termination, and traffic inspection Perform post-implementation testing and verification from the OS and network perspective to ensure end-to-end connectivity and application accessibility Security, Hardening Compliance Support Support and remediate findings related to: CIS hardening benchmarks (Windows Linux) Vulnerability scans and compliance checks Assist with: IAM role usage and least‑privilege access at instance level Endpoint protection / monitoring agents (EDR/XDR) Participate in audits, evidence collection, and compliance activities. Patch Management Automation Perform OS patching for: Windows (WSUS / SCCM / SSM Patch Manager) Linux (yum / apt / SSM Patch Manager) Support automation and remediation using: PowerShell (Windows) Shell scripting (bash) (Linux) AWS CLI Participate in scheduled maintenance windows and on‑call rotations. Documentation Operational Readiness Create and maintain: Runbooks SOPs Knowledge articles Support operational handover from project build to steady‑state support. Required Skills Experience Core Experience 5+ years of hands‑on OS support experience across Windows and/or Linux. 2+ years supporting workloads on AWS. Experience operating in enterprise or regulated environments. Technical Skills (Must‑Have) Windows Server administration (2016/2019/2022). Linux administration (RHEL / Amazon Linux / Ubuntu). AWS operational experience with: EC2, EBS, S3 IAM (roles and instance profiles – operational usage) Systems Manager (SSM) CloudWatch Understanding of: VPC fundamentals Security groups and basic routing Load balancer integrations (NLB awareness) Scripting skills: PowerShell (Windows) Bash / Shell scripting (Linux) Preferred Skills Certifications AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate Microsoft Windows Server or Hybrid Administrator certification Linux certifications (RHCSA or equivalent) ITIL Foundation (v3/v4) Soft Skills Strong troubleshooting and incident triage capability. Clear communicator able to work with cloud, network, and security teams. Process‑driven and comfortable working with runbooks and controls. Proactive, ownership mindset with willingness to upskill. review_candidates.description: Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture. About The Role The Empower System Engineer (QSC Lab Operations and Delivery) is accountable for the reliable, secure and compliant operation and lifecycle management of the Empower CDS, NuGenesis and Scitara systems and its supporting infrastructure. The role partners with Site Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and D&T teams to deliver stable QSC Lab services, execute changes and upgrades, and enable integrations across OT/IT layers in line with Good Manufacturing Practice (GxP) requirements. Key Responsibilities Provide software development for Empower, NuGenesis and Scitara Support design technical solutions and architecture of supported product/service which fulfill customer, regulatory, and system requirements Provide technical support for Empower, NuGenesis and Scitara services (environments, connectivity, performance, availability, backups, monitoring). Lead troubleshooting of complex incidents (L3) and drive root-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions. Execute and/or lead systems upgrades, patches, hardening activities and lifecycle refresh aligned to site schedules and validation strategy. With cooperation of central Tech teams support the underlying technology stack (servers/VMs, OS, network connectivity, databases, storage, identity/access) Ensure high availability, disaster recovery readiness, and robust backup/restore procedures for CMDB components. Support validation and audit activities by providing technical input for qualification, change impact assessments, and evidence generation. Ensure configurations and changes meet data integrity expectations (e.g., ALCOA+), compliance and security requirements. Design, implement and support integrations between systems and Engineering/automation layer (equipment connectivity, interfaces, protocols) Collaborate with Automation/Engineering teams to ensure robust, supportable interfaces and clear ownership across OT and IT boundaries. Create and maintain technical documentation (architecture, runbooks, SOP/WI, KBAs). Improve service reliability through proactive monitoring, automation and standardization across sites. Provide input and expertise to project/development teams and support/coordinate technical deliverables. Essential Qualifications and skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience. Experience (3-5+ years) in systems engineering / platform support in manufacturing or regulated environments. Demonstrable experience delivering complex technical changes (upgrades, migrations, integrations, deployments) with controlled change/validation. Knowledge of Oracle SQL for querying, analysing, and maintaining data. Familiarity of Agile, SDLC ways of working. Working knowledge of ITIL processes (incident/problem/change), with disciplined change execution. Familiarity with identity and access management concepts, system hardening, vulnerability remediation, and logging/monitoring. Equipment connectivity, data acquisition, and interface troubleshooting across OT/IT boundary. Soft Skills Ownership & accountability: drives issues to closure, raises risks early, ensures sustainable fixes. Collaboration: effective partner to central Tech teams, Quality, Manufacturing and Engineering. Structured problem solving: strong RCA, data-driven decisions, clear communication under pressure. Continuous improvement mindset: standardizes and automates where possible; improves reliability and supportability. Preferred Experience supporting Lab systems (ideally Empower CDS, NuGenesis, Scitara) Knowledge of software quality assurance techniques Basic knowledge of Networking: TCP/IP fundamentals, routing/switching concepts, VLANs, DNS/DHCP, firewalls, load balancing concepts, certificate/TLS basics. Why Haleon? None of us should ever feel like we’re standing still. At Haleon, we want you to feel supported, valued, and always progressing. Improving everyday health takes dedication, energy, and effort - so we reward your contribution with a benefits package that includes: Contract of employment Annual bonus that reflects performance Hybrid@Haleon our philosophy to hybrid work (2 days onsite per week) Private medical package (Medicover) with additional preventive healthcare services for employees and their eligible Multisport card or points on the Multicafeteria Benefits account Health and wellbeing programmes that take care of you physically and mentally Pension plan membership and savings programme (PPE) Personalized learning paths and access to diverse development tools to support your professional growth. Generali Life insurance Supportive community and integration events Family benefits (extra parental leave, caregiver’s policy) Free car and bike parking PLN 156 282,00 - PLN 214 887,20 The salary range for this position is indicative and provided as a guide. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people.
